subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Which public cron missed-run control should OpenClaw support for restart catch-up: expose the existing max/stagger knobs, add an explicit skip/freshness policy, or keep catch-up policy internal?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but `cron` config is public API and the choice directly changes when scheduled outbound messages are replayed, skipped, or delayed after restart.

options.title: Design Explicit Missed-Run Policy
options.body: Add a named global and/or per-job skip/freshness policy and only expose max/stagger as advanced tuning if maintainers want those raw knobs too.

options.title: Expose Existing Internal Knobs
options.body: Make `maxMissedJobsPerRestart` and `missedJobStaggerMs` public with schema, docs, tests, and a documented `0` behavior for disabling immediate catch-up.

options.title: Keep Policy Internal
options.body: Leave restart catch-up semantics as product-owned defaults and close or retitle this request to track only narrower duplicate-message bugs.

recommendation.title: Design Explicit Missed-Run Policy
recommendation.body: Add a named global and/or per-job skip/freshness policy and only expose max/stagger as advanced tuning if maintainers want those raw knobs too.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent direct history and verification context on cron restart policy and upgrade-sensitive catch-up behavior.
